Lumley Beach (Freetown)
Radiance and Ellie tandem-kite-foam across the shorebreak while Alia wades backward with a floating stabilizer, capturing their mirrored grins. Bumbuna Falls (Rokel River)
The four backfloat in the thunderous plunge pool, letting the cascade’s mist veil their faces, then scramble onto a moss-slick boulder for a breath. Radiance pecks Alia’s cheek mid-laugh, and Ellie feigns a jealous jaw-drop, mock-shoving her—but Alia catches Ellie’s ankle as she skids on wet stone, steadying her against the roar. They dissolve into a circle of floating bodies, backs to the falls, as an aerial drone tilts down from the crest into a slow-motion water-level push-in through the spray.

Dublin Bay (Banana Islands)
Alia and ECE scale a sea-stack’s natural stair, Radiance and Ellie tracing tidal pools below, until Alia pecks ECE’s brunette cheek in a moment of summit triumph—Ellie nudges Radiance with a theatrical groan, nearly knocking her off a barnacle ledge, but ECE’s outstretched arm (a gleaming haptic catch) locks Radiance’s waist before she falls. They all descend to a sun-warmed slab, shoulder-to-shoulder, as a handheld orbit circles their quiet poses, ending with a dolly zoom that tightens from the turquoise bay to their four reflective faces.
